tasks.short: Maintain care records and report observations to the supervisor

steps.what: Review the current patient care plan and recent progress records
Observe patient condition and identify care progress or problems requiring documentation
inputs: patient condition and actual care observations

steps.what: Write actual care, condition, progress and problems in the existing patient record
Check the progress note and exact observations to report to the supervisor
Report the checked observations to the responsible supervisor or case manager
Discuss reported care observations and unresolved problems with the supervisor
outputs: clarified care problems and next instructions

tasks.design: Use the current-plan view and existing progress-note fields in {OTHER}, the care-record application. The aide observes and writes actual facts, then checks and separately reports them before discussing problems with the supervisor.
tasks.previous_blocker: Care-plan navigation and repeated progress-note context add record handling.
tasks.enabler_now: Native patient views and note fields can preserve stable context without generating clinical conclusions.
tasks.still_hard: Meaningful changes and uncertain observations require attention and clarification.
tasks.human_edge: Notice the patient's changing condition and describe it accurately to the supervisor.
tasks.altitude: Reduce repeated progress-note handling while preserving observation and discussion.

reach.learn: Distinguish observed facts, uncertainty and requested help

evidence.claim: Native care-plan views and progress-note fields can reduce repeated handling; local savings are E1 assumptions.

assumptions: The progress note, report and supervisor discussion are all explicit parts of this task. No additional activity log is added; physical care delivery is not re-performed for the note.

The aide verifies patient and current plan in s1, produces actual observations in s2 and captures date, care facts, progress and uncertainty in s3. Capture and ordinary saves remain in 24.5 writing hours; missing information is clarified manually rather than filled as normal.

The current-plan view removes 2 of 10 navigation hours. Existing patient context, care headings and reusable unchanged fields remove 10.5 of 35 writing hours; actual observation narrative remains human.

Numeric vital-sign entries and specific teaching-outcome fields are priced under their respective tasks once; this task's general progress narrative and supervisor report remain here. Ordinary author saves need no approval; the gate binds the actual supervisor send.
research_questions: Does reuse reduce total record work while preserving actual condition changes and uncertainty?

already_counted.description: Write actual progress note and check the supervisor report

incremental.description: Maintain current patient view and note headings

approvals.approved_version: Exact observation report, patient identifier and internal supervisor recipient checked in s4; edits or recipient changes require a new check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B=100, R=87.5, gross 12.5 less 1 upkeep gives 11.5 net. Case-specific narrative and already available patient context retaining all navigation and 34 writing hours have their saving offset by upkeep. Reusable note context retaining nine navigation and 27.5 writing hours plus other 55 and 1 upkeep yield 7.5 net. Observation, final report check, real send and supervisor discussion remain fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Check and record pulse, temperature and respiration

steps.what: Prepare the patient and equipment for pulse, temperature and respiration checks
Check the patient's pulse, temperature and respiration using the appropriate technique
Enter observed readings and measurement context in the existing vital-sign record
Check recorded readings against observations and repeat questionable measurements as required

tasks.design: Use the existing vital-sign form in {OTHER}, the care-record application, with stable patient and measurement headings. The aide still prepares, measures, records actual readings and checks questionable observations; no sensor feed or automatic alert is assumed.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated record context surrounds the direct measurement.
tasks.enabler_now: Native vital-sign fields can preserve patient and unit headings.
tasks.still_hard: Correct technique and questionable readings require direct attention.
tasks.human_edge: Recognize unreliable measurements and follow the care instructions.
tasks.altitude: Reduce vital-record context entry without replacing measurement.

reach.learn: Use actual measurement context and uncertainty

evidence.claim: Native vital-sign fields can reduce repeated record context; measurement remains hands-on work.

assumptions: The numerical vital-sign record already supports care review. Its write is priced here once and is not counted again as general progress-note writing.

The aide produces pulse, temperature and respiratory rate in s2 and captures actual value, unit, patient and measurement time in s3. Capture remains inside 17 writing hours; no structured reading exists before measurement. Missing or questionable readings require manual remeasurement in s4.
Existing patient context and fixed unit headings remove 3 of 20 record hours; recording actual values, measurement context and ordinary saves remain.
No automatic out-of-range flag, alert, diagnosis or device integration is proposed. Supervisor reporting is separately priced under the explicit care-report task.
research_questions: Does the native form remove repeated context after recording actual readings and checking their units?

already_counted.description: Capture actual readings and check questionable measurements

approvals.approved_version: Exact measurement procedure for the verified patient and current care instructions; changed patient or conditions require renewed checking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B=100, R=97, gross 3 less 0.5 upkeep gives 2.5 net. Already native patient context retaining 19.5 record hours has its half-hour saving offset by upkeep. Partly reusable measurement context retaining 18 record hours plus other 80 and 0.5 upkeep yields 1.5 net. Preparation, measurement and rechecking remain fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Converse, entertain or read aloud to support patient engagement

steps.what: Ask about the patient's interests and choose a suitable conversation or reading
Entertain, converse with or read aloud to the patient responsively
Notice fatigue or disengagement and adapt the interaction to the patient

tasks.design: Retain choosing a shared interaction, personal conversation or reading and attention to the patient's response. A reading tool in {OTHER}, an accessibility application, may support the patient's own access, but it does not remove the aide's companionship time in this task.
tasks.previous_blocker: The work's purpose is shared human engagement.
tasks.enabler_now: No identified record or lookup operation removes that engagement.
tasks.still_hard: Meaningful companionship depends on listening and responsiveness.
tasks.human_edge: Know when to listen, continue or change the activity.
tasks.altitude: Preserve personal engagement with the patient.

reach.learn: Follow the person's own interests and energy

evidence.claim: Envision reads printed text aloud for accessibility; that capability does not establish a saving in the aide's human companionship task.

assumptions: There is no routine conversation transcript, activity log or written output specified for each interaction. General care changes worth reporting are captured once in the existing care-record task.
The aide obtains preferences in s1 and directly observes response in s3; all capture is retained. No machine consumes an inferred engagement or emotion score.
A document template, native record view or reading setting removes none of the priced shared interaction. Accessibility support would change the patient's access rather than eliminate companionship.
No new tool deployment or recurring upkeep is introduced in the saving case.
unknowns: Patient preferences for independent reading tools
research_questions: Does the person value an accessibility tool alongside, rather than as a replacement for, shared reading?

already_counted.description: Choose and adapt the shared interaction

incremental.description: No new system or capture requirement

approvals.approved_version: Exact preference questions and activity choices offered to the current patient; changed needs require reconsideration
Exact reading or conversation delivered responsively to the present patient; changed content or response requires reconsideration

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B=100, R=100 and no upkeep gives zero. Patients who enjoy reading and patients preferring conversation both retain selection, shared human engagement and response monitoring; no actual record-handling operation is identified for removal.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Provide emotional support and practical instruction to patients and families

steps.what: Review current care instructions and the patient's agreed support goals
Understand the family's immediate concerns and practical support needs
Provide responsive emotional support to the patient and family
Demonstrate practical care or independent living skills and check understanding
Write delivered instruction and remaining support needs in the existing care teaching fields

tasks.design: Use current support references in {OTHER}, the care-record application, and existing instruction materials in {DOCS}. Keep emotional support and practical teaching human, with actual instruction and remaining needs separately entered in the current teaching record.
tasks.previous_blocker: Care-instruction navigation and stable teaching-note context repeat handling.
tasks.enabler_now: Native reference links and existing teaching fields can reduce those actions.
tasks.still_hard: Emotional response and practical understanding require personal attention.
tasks.human_edge: Give support the family can use without exceeding the aide's clinical remit.
tasks.altitude: Reduce support-record repetition while retaining the relationship.

reach.learn: Use observed understanding and remaining needs rather than assumed competence

evidence.claim: Native care instruction links and teaching fields can reduce repeated context handling; relationship and practical instruction savings are not established.

assumptions: The existing care teaching fields document delivered instruction and remaining needs for subsequent care-team review. They are priced here once rather than duplicated in the general progress-note writing task. No new family-support activity log is introduced.

The aide checks current instruction and goals in s1, obtains actual concerns in s2 and observes understanding in s4 before capturing taught skill, date and remaining need in s5. Capture is included in 13.5 retained writing hours; unclear instructions are resolved manually with the supervisor.
Current instruction links remove 1 of 10 preparation hours. Stable teaching headings and patient context remove 1.5 of 15 writing hours; actual support narrative remains human.
Ordinary author saves remain retained without approval. No model-generated medical advice, referral send or automated family follow-up is implied.
unknowns: Current use and structure of care teaching fields
research_questions: Does existing field reuse reduce actual teaching-record repetition after capturing understanding accurately?

already_counted.description: Capture actual instruction and remaining support needs

incremental.description: Maintain current instruction references and teaching headings

approvals.approved_version: Exact questions and permitted care disclosures to the current patient and family; changed participants or scope require reconsideration
Exact emotional support delivered to the current patient and family within the aide's remit; changed needs require reconsideration
Exact practical instruction and demonstration consistent with current care directions; changed content or conditions require renewed checking

time_saved_range_pct.basis: E1 B=100, R=97.5, gross 2.5 less 0.5 upkeep gives 2 net. Already linked instructions and a current native note retain all preparation and 14.5 writing hours, offsetting the saving with upkeep. Partly reusable teaching context retaining 9.5 preparation and 14 writing hours plus other 75 and 0.5 upkeep yields 1 net. Emotional support, practical instruction and understanding checks remain fully retained.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: Retain direct care and patient relationships while making actual care records easier to maintain.
reach: Provide useful observations to nursing supervisors
Make family instruction and remaining needs visible
skills_to_grow: Separate record writing, reporting and discussion
role.ambitious_version: A home health aide with less repeated record context who personally observes patients, supports families and communicates concerns clearly.
